findings.title: Unclear button functionality
findings.problem: Buttons like 'Build this vehicle' and 'Confirm' do not visually indicate their function.
findings.why: Players might not understand what these buttons do, leading to confusion and potential errors in the car-building process.
findings.fix: Add a subtle icon or label next to each button to indicate its function, such as a checkmark for 'Confirm' and a wrench for 'Build this vehicle'.

findings.title: Inconsistent button design
findings.problem: Buttons on the constructor screen have different colors and styles, which can be confusing.
findings.why: Inconsistent design can lead to player confusion and a lack of visual hierarchy, making it hard to know which buttons are interactive or important.
findings.fix: Standardize button colors and styles across the constructor screen to create a consistent visual language.

findings.title: Unclear radar display
findings.problem: The radar display is not clearly indicating the player's orientation or the position of objects.
findings.why: A confusing radar can make it difficult for players to navigate and orient themselves in the game world, affecting gameplay and immersion.
findings.fix: Enhance the radar display by adding clearer markers for orientation and object positions, and possibly a legend explaining the symbols used.

findings.title: Cluttered information display
findings.problem: The information panels on the right side of the screen contain a lot of text and numbers, making it hard to read and understand quickly.
findings.why: Cluttered information can overwhelm players and make it difficult to absorb important game data at a glance, affecting decision-making and gameplay flow.
findings.fix: Reorganize the information panels to prioritize the most critical data, use larger fonts for key metrics, and possibly group related information together for better readability.

findings.title: Ambiguous vehicle status
findings.problem: The vehicle's status (e.g., armor, weapons) is not clearly indicated on the vehicle itself, only in the information panels.
findings.why: Players may not be aware of their vehicle's status without looking at the information panels, which can lead to surprises during gameplay and a lack of immersion.
findings.fix: Add visual indicators on the vehicle model itself to show armor points, weapon mounts, and other status details, making the information more immediately accessible.
